Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding uniform laws on the interstate provision of governmental services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to uniform laws on interstate provision ofgovernmental services; and adding a new section to chapter 43.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission shall consider proposing a draft uniform lawthat would enable the several states to contract among themselves andin their mutual interest, for the provision of state services so as toaccomplish savings that accrue from economies of scale. (2) The commission shall propose any draft uniform laws that resultfrom their consideration to the national conference of commissioners onuniform state laws, or its successors, for approval and adoption by theseveral states. If the commission finds after due consideration thata draft uniform law is not feasible, the commission shall so report tothe committees of the legislature having within their purview mattersrelated to governmental efficiency and effectiveness. (3) For purposes of this section, "state services" includes any andall services that facilitate the administration of government and the p. 1 SB 5739provision of governmental services, including, but not limited to,information technology.
